  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(sales_rep_id, deal_id)
    deal = Deal.find(deal_id)
    rep = SalesRepresentative.find(sales_rep_id)

    # Disburses commission without verifying deal.sales_rep_id
    rep.payout_account.transfer!(deal.commission_amount)
  end
end

class Sales::CommissionsController < ApplicationController
  def claim
    DisburseCommissionWorker.perform_async(current_rep.id, params[:deal_id])

  end
end

corrected_code:
class DisburseCommissionWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(sales_rep_id, deal_id)
    deal = Deal.find(deal_id)
    raise 'Deal does not belong to rep' unless deal.sales_rep_id == sales_rep_id

    rep = SalesRepresentative.find(sales_rep_id)
    rep.payout_account.transfer!(deal.commission_amount)
  end
end

class Sales::CommissionsController < ApplicationController
  def claim
    deal = current_rep.deals.find(params[:deal_id])
    DisburseCommissionWorker.perform_async(current_rep.id, deal.id)
    render json: { status: 'Commission payout initiated' }
  end
end
